thread:
sara.amps: FYI - ArcadiaHealth sent an RFP asking for a HIPAA-friendly POC plan, quantization support, and a short SLA summary. They attached the RFP doc: https://drive.company/arcadia_rfp_q2.docx. Can someone draft succinct answers?

deploy-bot: Uploaded file `arcadia_rfp_q2.docx` (1.6MB) to #sales thread.

ben.sales: I can lead. Quick asks we should cover: 1) HIPAA controls for POC 2) model quantization impact on quality 3) SLA for Dedicated vs Hosted 4) POC timeline & success criteria 5) pricing/credits.

liam.prod: Product input first: For quantization we support int8 and int4 runtimes for selected model families; int4 reduces GPU memory by ~40-50% but expect a small quality delta depending on task. Recommend we propose a split POC: initial run on fp16 hosted for parity tests, then a quantized run on Dedicated to show cost savings. POC duration 3 weeks: week 1 ingest & baseline, week 2 tuning & eval, week 3 scale tests and handoff. Success criteria: embedding similarity delta < 2% vs baseline, p95 latency target met, and no privacy incidents.

anita.sec: Security/HIPAA notes: For hosted POC we can enable isolated tenant storage, encryption-at-rest with customer-managed KMS, and strict access controls. For any PHI ingestion we require a signed BAA and DPA before data transfer. Audit logs retained 30 days by default for the POC; we can extend on request. We must also confirm they want log redaction for PHI in traces. Add: network egress must be confined to approved CIDR ranges for Private deployments.

ben.sales: Good — can you draft the HIPAA sentence I can copy into the RFP?

anita.sec: Draft HIPAA blurb: "Redwood will enter a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and Data Processing Agreement (DPA) prior to any PHI transfer. For the POC we offer an isolated tenant, customer-managed KMS, audit logging, and optional log-redaction; we will not surface PHI in developer dashboards."

liam.prod: SLA bullets to propose: Hosted eval 1-day uptime expectation, best-effort support, and response SLOs during business hours. Dedicated (reserved) SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime and 24/7 incident response for critical incidents, with optional runbooks & on-call support add-on. Include a fallback policy: if reserved capacity is unavailable we can route to compatible model variant with degraded performance and notify the customer.

ben.sales: Pricing + credits input?

doug.finance: Recommend: POC credit $6,500 covering hosted baseline + engineering support (up to 20h). If they request a Dedicated reserved cluster for the quantized tests, propose a short-term commit starting at $15k/mo (30-day minimum). For egress: include first 250GB free for POC, then $0.12/GB over that. Also note any third-party cloud egress charges will be passed through for Private deployments.

liam.prod: Add a short technical snippet for quantization validation they can paste:

```bash
# run fp16 baseline
redwood infer --model x-large-fp16 --input sample.json --output baseline.json
# run int8 quantized
redwood infer --model x-large-int8 --input sample.json --output q8.json
# compute embed sim delta
python eval/embedding_delta.py baseline.json q8.json
```

ben.sales: Perfect. Anita, any security caveat to tack on to the quantization answer?

anita.sec: We should state: "Quantized models do not change our encryption or access model; weights on-disk are encrypted and keys remain customer-controlled when KMS is enabled. However, if you require FIPS-140 HSM-backed key material for key usage, that is only supported in Private/HSM deployments and needs a separate SOW."

ben.sales: OK I'm assembling. Can we also add a one-paragraph exec summary for the RFP? Something short and to-the-point.

liam.prod: Exec paragraph draft: "Redwood proposes a 3-week POC to validate model quality and cost tradeoffs for ArcadiaHealth. We will demonstrate parity on hosted fp16 baselines, then run quantized tests on a Dedicated environment to show potential cost reduction. The engagement includes security controls required for HIPAA workloads and a final findings report with recommended serving configuration and cost estimates."

ben.sales: Nice. Quick checklist before I finalize the RFP response: 1) Confirm BAA/DPA process (anita) 2) Final POC credit and egress numbers (doug) 3) Confirm quantization families supported (liam) 4) Attach pricing sheet & SOW template (I'll upload). Can we ship by EOD?

anita.sec: BAA/DPA process confirmed. We have a standard BAA template we can attach; legal will expedite for POCs under $10k credit.

/doug.finance uploads arcadia_poc_pricing_v2.xlsx

deploy-bot: Uploaded file `arcadia_poc_pricing_v2.xlsx` (28KB) to #sales thread.

doug.finance: Final numbers: POC credit $6,500 covers hosted work + first 250GB egress. Overages at $0.12/GB. Dedicated short-term commit: $15k/month minimum, 30-day min. Support hours beyond included 20h billed at $250/hr.

liam.prod: Supported quantization families: gptx-family (fp16/int8/int4) and falcon-family (fp16/int8). We'll call out that int4 is experimental for some architectures and we'll run a quality gate.

ben.sales: Great. I'll assemble and attach final RFP answers and send to Arcadia contact. Thanks team :rocket:

anita.sec: Add contact for HIPAA/security follow-ups: anita.sec@redwood.ai

sara.amps: Thanks everyone — sending now.
